published.source: priest client 70425 port (DP 24 s, talents and knobs re-searched with raid hits), 2026-10-16

summary: Deep Shadow (Shadowform, Shadow Weaving, Darkness, Improved Mind Flay, Early Demise) with 15 Discipline points for Twin Disciplines, Mental Strength and Inner Focus and 3 Holy points for Twilight Focus's pushback protection. The talent search's best priest build and the spec's default Level 60 preset.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadowform at -3 s, Mind Blast at -1.5 s that lands at the pull; the on-use trinket and Major Spellblasting Potion at -0.1 s
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 10% mana; racials and trinkets on cooldown
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is down (9+ s left in the fight)
Devouring Plague whenever it is down and off its 24 s cooldown (12+ s left)
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown, then Inner Focus right before Mind Blast and Mind Blast on cooldown
Mind Flay to fill; clipped after the second tick if SW:P or Devouring Plague fell off, never clipped for Mind Blast
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 36 spell power and 15 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Synthetic Phase 1 gear (not in the game), only the 2-piece set bonus is live; Raiments 4/5-piece (Devouring Plague without a cooldown) not re-measured since its cooldown dropped to 24 s
Periodic spells roll crit per tick (global Forever rule); Shadow Weaving assumed to apply to the priest's own Shadow damage on every target
Mind Flay rolls hit once and its channel is not hasted; SW:Death backlash ignored and SW:Death numbers are untested in beta
Brilliant Wizard Oil left out as a Zul'Gurub recipe (+12.5); Elixir of Sages left out by the one-crit-elixir ruling (+13.9)
Human since client 70425's Ruthless (2% crit with any weapon): Undead is the best Horde race, 3.7 behind at 180 s
Improved Mind Flay (70425) read as compounding, each tick 20% more than the one before (1, 1.2, 1.44); Dark Inspiration's party Spirit is applied to the priest only
Mana barely binds (about 13 min to empty)
notes: Request from mksettings unchanged (spec shadow, 180 s, durationVariation 20); it matches the shipped encounter and DefaultConsumes.
